Agent Name: FileSurfer
, Step Number: 56
, Reason for Mistake: FileSurfer proposed an approach that filtered Regression-labeled issues by searching for the keyword “numpy.polynomial” in the title/body instead of intersecting the correct labels (“06 - Regression” and “component: numpy.polynomial”). This methodological error led the team to select a 2022 issue rather than the true oldest closed numpy.polynomial Regression issue from 2018, producing the wrong final date (11/24/22 instead of 04/15/18).
